notes.title: Halloween Update Haunts Operation: Polygon Storm!
notes.notes:
Salutations, Commanders!

We hope that you’re hungry for combat and some pumpkin juice. As the Spooky Season approaches, we’ve prepared some treats for you…

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/99c7ff81896f388ce6e0484d694c76a364bfdbe7.gif
HALLOWEEN EVENT  ╾━╤デ╦︻

From October 25th to November 6th, mysterious occurrences might happen during your battle…  It’s time for the Halloween Event! Your enemies might turn into something uncanny and you’ll enjoy Airport and Fallen City maps in their spookiest version yet! Lock n’ load and get ready for some horrific mayhem!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43623914/f6e46b3e0e853fb254dd41a6751d7ba91faef404.gif

If you want to relive the scares and frights, worry not, for the Holiday Event System we implemented in this patch allows you to toggle the Halloween event from the Menu.

[hr][/hr]
TOXIC BARREL  ╾━╤デ╦︻

A new, treacherous ability that enemies will bring for 4 last maps. Watch your step!

[hr][/hr]

But that’s not all! In the update, you’ll also find:
 
- scrolling for abilities and units in the loadout menu
- all-new, shiny camo patterns, so your troops can stay hidden AND stylish

[hr][/hr]

Fixes:
You no longer have to replay The Last Company map to unlock a new DLC map. Have fun!

[hr][/hr]


Also, reminder about the DLC we released a couple days ago:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280600/Operation_Polygon_Storm__Chernobyl_DLC/

Stay tuned for more news!

[hr][/hr]

Be sure to follow our friends at Untold Tales for more intel

Hello, generals!

After a second round of feedback, we're now ready to release a second patch with the fixes! 

Hotfix 1.2 Changelog:


 Fixed an issue where a hacker and bitcoin van could farm money from their base
 Fixed an issue where the player was not receiving rewards when exiting infinite mode through the menu
 Fixed an issue where a player could not activate a gift code - PARTIAL FIX, players will now receive the item, but the message will still say "invalid code" - we're working on a permament fix
 Fixed an issue where the achievement "finish the map without losing towers" was achievable under the opposite condition
 Fixed an issue where it was not possible to get the achievement for completing all maps on hard
 Fixed an issue where the "kill all bosses in infinite mode" achievement could not be obtained
 Fixed an issue where a helicopter boss was not spawning in infinite mode
 Fixed inflated difficulty on Desert Citadel map
 Fixed an issue where certain progression blocks for the Engineer, Bitcoin Van, and Artillery were not being saved.
 Fixed an issue with a helicopter where it was missing a propeller sound
 Fixed an issue where an event car on the Desert Citadel map could destroy a DLC skinned car
 Fixed an issue where a player could not get the turret terror achievement 
 NEW FEATURE: Rewritten the reward system for endless mode. Added cash rewards for completing the endless mode for a certain amount of points. Added display of money received in the map menu of the endless mode

notes.title: Steam Summer Festival - Massive Update 0.7.53!
notes.notes:
Steam Summer Fest is here! New Features, bug fix, huge AI improvements and more. Let us know what you are thinking about in Discord

Features:
Huge AI improvements
You can now control units (for now it works only with move and attack orders)
Added Progression system
Added difficulties to each map
You can now see a big wave announcement each 5’s wave
Performance optimization and improvements
Added 2 new unlock vehicle: M1 Abrams and HMVVW
You can now move camera forward and backward with W and S
Now you can only use your abilities on a certain area
Vehicles now don’t have colliders
RPG Trooper and Tank now do more ragdoll force
Artillery now shoo through our Tower
Armored Car now spawn 0 Troopers by default and +3 with full progression 
Armored car now has Trooper on the top
In game UI description increased in size 
Himars now has UI reloading indicator
Infantry now less effective against Vehicles


Bugs:
The Flag goes underground
Explosion barrels floating in space
After Win/Lose game does not pause 
More minor bug fix and improvements
